title: ChemInform Abstract: Chemistry of N‐Chloronortropine Derivatives: Synthesis of a Bridged Aziridine Compound and New Tropane Derivatives.
abstract: AbstractN‐Halogenation of Nortropanone (I) with tert‐butyl hypochlorite and subsequent column chromatography on basic aluminum oxide yield the bridged aziridine (III) which is cleaved upon reaction with the compounds (IV) or dimethyl acetylenedicarboxylate (VI), forming the nortropanones (V) or the azabicyclo(5.1.0)octenone (VII).
